title: A failed verification records the findings that failed it
description: a failed verification records the findings that failed it
acceptance_criteria: A failed verification command records a bounded output of the findings that failed it (errors, and warnings only under --strict), and a gate refusal records its refusal texts, so a recorded failure is classifiable without re-running it; passing records are byte-identical to before; the 4 KiB tail never splits a character and keeps the error that failed the check

answers.constraints: change.3md #640 plane: optional-and-skipped is the only way to grow the ledger; passing records stay byte-identical
